layers.name: Presentation/Gateway Layer
layers.description: REST API controllers, guards, interceptors, request/response DTOs, and route handling for the Gateway service. Exposes HTTP endpoints and handles authentication, validation, and response formatting.

layers.name: Application/Business Layer
layers.description: Business logic services, GraphQL resolvers, and application orchestration. Contains the core domain operations for auth, posts, social, and user management across all microservices.

layers.name: Data Access Layer
layers.description: TypeORM entities, database modules, Neo4j integration, and data persistence. Defines the database schema and provides repository-based data access for MySQL and graph database operations.

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.description: Cross-cutting infrastructure services including configuration management, logging, caching (Redis), authentication utilities (bcrypt), GraphQL federation router, and metrics/monitoring.

layers.name: Shared/Common Layer
layers.description: Shared DTOs, interfaces, enums, decorators, and type definitions used across all microservices. Provides the common vocabulary and contract definitions for the entire application.

layers.name: DevOps/Configuration Layer
layers.description: Docker orchestration, Apollo Router federation config, environment files, build tooling, CI/CD scripts, and development tooling configuration.

tour.title: Gateway Entry Point
tour.description: Start with the Gateway service entry point to understand how the NestJS application bootstraps and how the root AppModule wires together all features.

tour.title: Gateway REST Routing & Guards
tour.description: Explore how the Gateway routes HTTP requests through controllers, applies JWT authentication guards, and uses interceptors for request tracing and response mapping.

tour.title: Gateway Auth & Posts Services
tour.description: Understand how the Gateway services use the GraphQL router composite to communicate with backend microservices, implement Redis caching, and manage JWT sessions.

tour.title: Auth Microservice
tour.description: Dive into the Auth microservice: its GraphQL federation setup, user registration/login mutations, session management, and TypeORM entities for MySQL.

tour.title: Posts Microservice
tour.description: Explore the Posts microservice: GraphQL federation configuration, post CRUD resolvers, TypeORM entity definitions, and paginated query patterns.

tour.title: Social Microservice (Neo4j)
tour.description: Discover the Social microservice: how it uses Neo4j graph database for follow/unfollow relationships, Cypher queries, and the SocialService lifecycle.

tour.title: Shared Library: Core Infrastructure
tour.description: Learn about the shared library's bootstrap utility, logging with Pino, Redis caching, MySQL database module, and configuration management.

tour.title: Shared Library: GraphQL Federation Client
tour.description: Understand the GraphQL router composite pattern, the GenQL client for type-safe cross-service communication, and the federated schema definitions.

tour.title: Shared Library: DTOs & Validation
tour.description: Review the response DTOs, validation pipes for REST and GraphQL, custom validators, and shared interfaces that enforce consistent API contracts.

tour.title: Infrastructure: Docker & Databases
tour.description: See how Docker Compose orchestrates MySQL, Redis, Neo4j, and Apollo Router, and how the Apollo supergraph config composes the three subgraphs.

tour.title: Development Workflow
tour.description: Explore the monorepo tooling: NestJS CLI configuration, PM2 for running services, schema generation scripts, Vitest testing, ESLint, and Husky pre-commit hooks.
